Spatial prediction
Cooper ascent arrives south of Press after a quarter turn.
Laundry reaches a bent passage through the Press building.
The east receiving street then offers the bridge or the
occupied S4 house; they remain decisions after initial
contact.
Support / opposing response
Passage bends interrupt instant follower trades. Press is
full-height masonry: support must move to the next mouth.
The east street was widened during joining so it is not a
sub-body pinch beside the press wall.
Affected: M03, M05, M06, I04, S2a, S2b, D05, D06, D07.
Walk routes: R02, R07, R09. All circles are body centers,
not measured camera poses.

L02 / geometry prediction. Later capture each listed stance from both sides, include the follower, and inspect standing/crouched exposure plus all intermediate stair or ramp
positions. Roofs and slabs remain opaque. Movement openings and observation apertures are different contracts.
